Restore the recovered neuron/time/trial component-result obligation, with exact original component/condition meaning, gauges, source views and scientific relationships authenticated before admission; factor export is computational evidence, not completion. Fourteen R2 matches, lower training error or more restarts cannot qualify the full family. No invented scalar or unresolved placeholder finding stands in for missing native findings.

Retained source-specific qualifications:

Retain the declared recovered-component, reconstruction-versus-rank/type and held-out decoding findings as separately identified obligations, with each original source panel and its indispensable controls authenticated before admission. Higher trajectory R² alone does not establish completion of this retained result family. Assess improvement only on an explicitly identified original same-result comparison, preserving its required companion findings.

permitted_observations.description: Both paper conditions may inspect the paper, including its printed claims/tables, and the same authenticated original neural observations, behavioral/condition metadata and declared training labels. Original source whole-session neuronwise scaling and unsupervised decomposition exposure must be disclosed; no strict unseen-trial representation-learning claim is inferred. Preserve the source 10-ms bins, preprocessing, lag and all relevant observations; do not silently replace ridge-alpha-1 plus penalized appended constant with paper OLS or replace the unresolved physical time window. The operator must independently execute the submitted analysis on authentic inputs and verify trial-identified predicted displacement/position trajectories, representation reconstructions/factors and fold masks, decoder coefficients/recipe, raw and condition-average controls, and every source-mapped Churchland component relationship and reconstruction/model-comparison output with original gauge/condition identities, mask/trim support, residual numerators/denominators and derived contrasts. Copying printed R2 values or source claims, or printing them from an executable, cannot satisfy reproduction. Authentic input, allowed-observation and output-identity manifests, participant transport and independent execution/verifier bindings are not yet frozen. This is bounded Churchland coverage: the paper itself is available in both intended conditions, but its unrecovered component/rank mapping cannot be inferred from code names. No IBL/Wagner or all-figure observation expansion is authorized.
